why_v2: v1 (MLX 8-bit on Ryan's Mac) wired about 37.5 GB and lagged the Mac, so its full-VAL stage was paused after invocations 1-3 (runs/aircraft-named-baseline-v1-run2). MLX is Apple-only and cannot run on the UWaterloo hosts. v2 runs the same base model from the author's unquantized weights with transformers on CPU on the ram pool.
must_not_run_until: Root review approves this plan and writes an activated copy (activated true, activation.activated_at, activation.approved_by, every sources_pinned value filled with the merged code's SHA256) committed before the first model call; the runner refuses anything else and requires that copy's SHA256 on every invocation.
The runtime pins below are installed on every shard host (the runner refuses any other version set) and the weights pass the integrity record on that host.
scope: Named open-weight comparator on FGVC-Aircraft 2013b native VALIDATION only. No TEST image is opened, decoded, synced or predicted. No training. The only download is the pinned author snapshot, onto the shard hosts.

baseline_identity.name: Qwen3.8-27B (author bf16 weights, computed in float32), native instruct profile, transformers on CPU
baseline_identity.claim_label: Qwen3.8-27B (author bf16 weights, fp32 compute, transformers CPU) native-instruct (direct answer), single seeded sample per image
baseline_identity.identity_change_vs_v1: v1 evaluated mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-8bit@815b83c0 (8-bit affine, group 64) converted from this same upstream revision (docs/local-qwen3.8-27b-8bit-provenance.json upstream_revision_checked 1d4bf0f2). v2 evaluates the author bf16 weights themselves, so the two are the same base model at different numerics: v2 is the unquantized author model, v1 a lossy 8-bit conversion. The engine also changes (mlx-vlm 0.6.8 on Metal -> transformers 5.20.0 on CPU, float32 compute over the exactly upcast bf16 weights), and the random stream changes (MLX -> torch.Generator) while the sampling definition stays the mlx-vlm one. A v2 result is therefore NOT a v1 result and is never labelled as the 8-bit model.
baseline_identity.v1_results_not_merged: No v1 run-2 artifact (discovery 34/100 twice, full-VAL invocations 1-3) is read, copied, resumed or pooled by v2. v2 regenerates every discovery and full-VAL image from scratch. v1 numbers may be quoted beside v2 only with their own label.
baseline_identity.not_claimed: Not the strongest Qwen3.8 profile (xhigh thinking stays unmeasured, as in v1). Bit-identical outputs to any GPU or MLX run are not claimed.

model.directory: host-local, passed as --weights; the snapshot lives in /dev/shm/r226lin-qwen38-27b-1d4bf0f2 on each shard host because /var/tmp on iccad1/3/5 has 11-54 GB free and the snapshot is 55.6 GB (uwrun hosts ram, 2026-10-18)
model.verification: local_hf.verify_snapshot rehashes all 32 files before each load: sha256 of each LFS file (18 safetensors + tokenizer.json) and the git blob SHA-1 of every other file, as published by the Hub API; strict loader, trust_remote_code false, offline
model.python: uv venv -p 3.12 on each host, then <venv>/bin/python -I
model.runtime_pins_source: uv pip freeze of the iccad3 setup run qwen38hf-setup-iccad3 (2026-10-18); transformers/tokenizers/pillow/numpy/safetensors equal v1's runtime pins; torch from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu, the same torch/torchvision pair CI's local-vlm job installs; torchvision is required by the Qwen3-VL processor in transformers 5.20.0 (the first smoke launch failed without it); httpx is imported by vision_rl.evaluation and is not a runtime pin
model.install: uv pip install --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu torch==2.14.1 torchvision==0.29.1 && uv pip install httpx==0.28.1 transformers==5.20.0 tokenizers==0.23.3 pillow==12.3.0 numpy==2.5.4 safetensors==0.8.0 huggingface_hub

engine.name: transformers-cpu
engine.dtype_rule: Compute in float32: the author bf16 weights are loaded with dtype=float32, an exact upcast (every bf16 value is representable in float32), so the weights are the author's values and only activations are computed at higher precision. bf16 compute is not supported natively by the ram-pool CPUs (Xeon E5-2667 v2 / Ivy Bridge: AVX without AVX2, FMA or AVX512-BF16; torch cpu_capability DEFAULT), so torch emulates it, and it was measured impractical (dtype_evidence). The dtype is part of the run identity, so shards cannot silently differ; changing it needs a new plan version.
engine.dtype_evidence: reports/2026-10-18-named-baseline-v2-smoke: bf16 on iccad3 had not finished TRAIN image 0447760 after about 3,120 s of generation and was stopped; float32 finished the same image in 504.6 s (iccad3) and 859.7 s (iccad1).
engine.threads: operational, not identity: --threads per shard, recorded in each ledger start and in load_info
engine.implementation: scripts/aircraft_named_baseline_hf.py (TransformersBackend, run_local_hf; kept out of src/vision_rl because pre-registered plans hash every module there); journal loop is local_vlm._run_locked unchanged
engine.sampler_equivalence: local_hf.mlx_filter reproduces mlx-vlm 0.6.8 make_logits_processors + make_sampler: presence penalty 1.5 on unique tokens among the last 20 generated tokens, log-softmax, top-p 0.8 on the untempered distribution (keep where ascending cumulative probability > 0.2), top-k 20, categorical draw at temperature 0.7. The draw is made in the logits processor with torch.Generator seeded by the per-image seed; generate() runs greedy over a one-hot row with the author generation_config replaced by a neutral one, and the emitted tokens are compared with the drawn tokens (any difference is refused).
engine.stop_rule: finish_reason stop iff the last generated token is one of the author generation_config eos_token_id; the eos token is not part of the text (as mlx-vlm); otherwise length at max_tokens

generation.sampling_source: vision_rl.local_vlm.INSTRUCT_GENERATION (author-card native instruct values); identical to the measured chunk1 probe
generation.decoding_protocol: One seeded native-sampled completion per image (pass@1). The eight endpoints are greedy; this difference is disclosed, not equalised, because the baseline must use its supported native profile.
generation.output_budget_note: The native 16,384-token ceiling is kept. No reduced cap is imposed to cause truncation.
generation.memory_note: No MLX limit. A float32 shard process peaked at 164.7 GB RSS in the smoke; the shard hosts had 441-490 GB available (uwrun hosts ram, 2026-10-18) and also hold the 52 GB snapshot in /dev/shm. One shard per host.

prompt_and_parser.same_as: vision_rl.vlm_local_evaluation (eight-endpoint native-VAL evaluator): prompt_text(spec, "answer_only") over the complete 100-label vocabulary, parse_label(response, labels, allow_reasoning=True) only for a normally terminated generation
prompt_and_parser.prompt_sha256_evidence: Equal to prompt_sha256 in runs/aircraft-native-val-activation-v1/bundle/plan.json and to runs/local-qwen8bit/aircraft-native-instruct-plan/prompt.txt (shasum -a 256, 2026-10-17); recomputed from data_spec by jq with the prompt_text formula.
prompt_and_parser.parser_source_sha256_evidence: sha256 of the parse_label source text in the evaluator frozen copy (runs/aircraft-native-val-activation-v1/frozen/src) and on main c966df4 (identical), equal to parser_source_sha256 in the native-instruct probe plan.
prompt_and_parser.terminated_rule: finish_reason == "stop"; otherwise the answer is None (invalid, counted wrong)
prompt_and_parser.no_repair: Raw generated text is retained; no answer repair, fuzzy matching or retry.
prompt_and_parser.formatted_prompt_evidence: frontier._digest of the chat-templated prompt recorded by every completed v1 image (runs/aircraft-named-baseline-v1-run2/stage-discovery/run/attempts.jsonl, one distinct value) and by the MLX TRAIN probe (runs/local-qwen8bit/aircraft-native-instruct-probe); the v2 engine refuses any image whose templated prompt differs

inputs.image_preprocessing: fgvc-aircraft-rgb-remove-bottom20-v1 (shared aircraft_data transform; original JPEG, RGB, bottom 20 rows removed, no box crop, no external resize, no EXIF transposition); run_local rehashes model-visible pixels before each image

sources_pinned_note: local_vlm.py, local_vlm_execution.py and the v1 runner are byte-identical to main da4e401 (the v1 run hashes them, so v2 does not edit them). The two null pins are filled at activation with the merged commit's file hashes; an activated plan with any null pin is refused. All runner sources are also hashed into each shard ledger at its first invocation and must not change afterwards.

sharding.assignment: author-order position i of the stage manifest belongs to shard i mod 3 (metadata only)
sharding.hosts: one shard per ram-pool host (iccad1, iccad3, iccad5), each with its own copy of the snapshot in /dev/shm and its own run directory; which shard runs on which host is operational and recorded by uwrun
sharding.merge: scripts/aircraft_named_baseline_v2.py merge: union of the shard journals; refuses an image journaled in two shards or outside its shard, a shard directory outside shard-k-of-3, shards whose run identities differ in anything but their rows/shard index, and any missing or unknown image
sharding.shared_state: Shards share no lock. Shard results are fetched to one output directory before merge; the merge refuses duplicates, so running one shard twice cannot be double-counted.

discovery.selection: Within each of the 100 classes, the native-VAL ID with the lowest SHA256 of compact JSON ["fgvc-aircraft-2013b","fgvc-aircraft-freshpool-screened-grpo-v1","baseline-discovery",791,label,id] (salt pinned by decision D13); evaluated in author order. Metadata only; no image or model output consulted.
discovery.ids_evidence: Computed with jq -c and shasum -a 256 over audit/val-images.json by two independent jq reductions that agree; the runner recomputes it in Python and refuses on any difference.
discovery.report: numerator, denominator, exact IDs, macro (= micro by balance), invalid/unterminated answers, finish reasons, native tokens, generation and charged active seconds; a partial run reports completed counts and metric null

budget.derivation: per shard (34/33/33 images, one invocation each if nothing fails): image_seconds 1800 is 3.0x the slowest float32 smoke image on iccad3 (596.6 s) and 2.1x the slowest on iccad1 (859.7 s); load 1200 s covers the measured snapshot rehash plus load (about 190 s on iccad3); long_generation_allowance 100000 s covers one native 16,384-token answer at the slowest measured decode rate (6.1 s/token, iccad3 image 0447760), so a long answer is not truncated by the wall cap; wall cap = 1200 + 34 x 1800 + 100000 = 162400 s; max_active = 3 wall caps

discovery.regenerated: Same 100 IDs as v1, regenerated by v2; v1 discovery outputs are not reused.

full.ids_evidence: sha256 of compact JSON list of all image_id values of audit/val-images.json in author order (jq -c, shasum -a 256).
full.regenerates_discovery_images: Yes: full VAL is its own run; discovery outputs are never copied into it.

gate.requires: every discovery shard completed with zero unknown and zero hard-stop outcomes, under this activated plan's SHA256 and the same runner sources
gate.projection: per shard: ceil(3333/3) x discovery mean image latency + ceil(ceil(3333/3) / chunk_images) x max(discovery mean load seconds, discovery charged seconds not spent generating / discovery invocations)
gate.shard_max_active_seconds: min(max_projected_shard_active_seconds, active_cap_multiplier x projection); a hard ceiling per shard
gate.ceiling_consistency: proceed only if projection + one full invocation wall cap <= shard_max_active_seconds
gate.on_stop: Report the named comparator as incomplete. Do not change prompt, profile, output budget, dtype or sample to rescue it; any change is a new plan version.
gate.headroom: Not gated here; a root decision.

budget.max_active_seconds: derived per shard by the gate
budget.derivation: per shard of 1,111 images: 18 chunks of 64 needed, 24 allowed; wall cap = 1200 + 64 x 1800 + 100000 = 216400 s; calendar 28 days

budget_semantics.invocation_wall_seconds: load_allowance_seconds + chunk_images x image_seconds + long_generation_allowance_seconds (discovery 8700 s, full 18060 s); passed to the external supervisor as --wall-limit-seconds
budget_semantics.long_generation_allowance: 2100 s covers one 16,384-token generation at the slowest measured 8.2 tokens/s, so a long native answer is not truncated by the wall cap
budget_semantics.charging: A finished invocation is charged its measured elapsed seconds; a started invocation with no finish record is charged its full wall cap.
budget_semantics.survives_resume: The ledger's first start time and invocation count are never reset.
budget_semantics.refusals: A new invocation is refused when any of: invocations >= max_invocations, charged active seconds + the invocation wall cap > max_active_seconds (so the cap is a hard ceiling while the supervisor enforces the wall cap), calendar >= max_calendar_seconds, run output >= max_output_bytes, an unfinished prior invocation, or any unknown/hard-stop outcome (human review, no automatic continuation).
budget_semantics.scope: Every budget is per shard: each shard has its own ledger.jsonl under stage-<stage>/shard-<k>-of-3/ and its own invocation count, active seconds and calendar clock.

supervision.command: uwrun run --host <iccad1|iccad3|iccad5> --sync <staged tree> --threads <T> --timeout <invocation_wall_seconds + 900> --name <name> -- <venv>/bin/python -I scripts/aircraft_named_baseline_v2.py run --plan <ACTIVATED.json> --expected-plan-sha256 <sha> --stage <stage> --shard <k> --weights /dev/shm/r226lin-qwen38-27b-1d4bf0f2 --threads <T> --output <shared output>
supervision.wall_limit: uwrun --timeout TERMs then KILLs the process group at the bound; a killed invocation has no finish record and is charged its full wall cap
supervision.memory: No MLX/Metal limit applies. A float32 shard process peaked at 164.7 GB RSS (smoke, both hosts); the hosts have 441-490 GB available plus the 52 GB /dev/shm snapshot. One shard per host.
supervision.one_invocation_at_a_time: run_local_hf holds an exclusive lock on its shard run directory; no automatic retries
supervision.staged_tree: src/, scripts/, docs/ (plan + integrity), data/fgvc-aircraft-2013b/{audit/val-images.json, development/validation.jsonl, development/images/validation/, candidates/fourshot-seed791/data_spec.json} only; never data/fgvc-aircraft-2013b/sealed

measured_cost.instrument: reports/2026-10-18-named-baseline-v2-smoke (scripts/aircraft_named_baseline_v2.py smoke; uwrun runs qwen38hf-smoke-fp32-iccad1-r2, qwen38hf-smoke-fp32-iccad3, qwen38hf-smoke-bf16-iccad3-r3)
measured_cost.split: TRAIN only (0447760, 1158113, 0090868, 0489934); never VAL or TEST
measured_cost.decode_seconds_per_token_iccad3: 2.9-6.1 (from latency minus prefill over the remaining generated tokens)
measured_cost.bfloat16: iccad3: image 0447760 unfinished after about 3,120 s, stopped; impractical on these CPUs
measured_cost.host_conditions: Both hosts were shared with other users' jobs during the smoke (load average 19-44 on 32 logical CPUs); per-host numbers only, not dedicated-hardware figures
measured_cost.projection_full_val: 3,333 images / 3 shards = 1,111 per shard. At 398.1 / 465.9 / 533.7 s per image: 122.9 / 143.8 / 164.7 h of generation per shard (about 5.1 / 6.0 / 6.9 days of wall clock with 3 shards in parallel), plus about 200 s per invocation x 18. One host alone: 368.6 / 431.3 / 494.1 h. Discovery: 34 images per shard, about 3.8-5.0 h. Not a forecast: VAL images run up to 1.9 MP (largest smoke image 1.67 MP), and the full-stage cap is derived from the discovery measurement
measured_cost.consistency_with_v1: All 8 float32 images reproduce v1's templated-prompt sha c4409cac..., and the two images shared with v1's MLX TRAIN probe (0447760, 1158113) have identical input_ids_shape, pixel_values_shape and image_grid_thw. Both hosts produced identical answers from the same seeds.

analysis.metric: mean(diag(row_normalized_confusion)) (equal-class accuracy) via vision_rl.classification_comparison, plus image (micro) accuracy; invalid, unterminated and missing answers stay in class denominators
analysis.comparisons_after_full: compare: the merged baseline versus each declared arm on all 3,333 native-VAL images; equal-class difference with compare_classification's paired bootstrap (stratified image and class-cluster CIs) and image-accuracy difference with a paired image bootstrap, both 20,000 draws, seed 2718
analysis.claim_limits: A full native-VAL baseline claim requires all 3,333 merged predictions with zero unknown. The discovery sample is a resource-sizing and validity diagnostic, never a benchmark score or a win. Frontier superiority still requires the frozen native TEST, which this plan does not touch.

arms.name: strongest_SFT
arms.meaning: strongest declared SFT endpoint by the evaluator's pre-declared rule (comparison.json strongest_declared_sft)

arm_source.export: scripts/aircraft_named_baseline_v2.py export-arm --bundle <bundle> --arm <evaluator_arm> --out <arm>.json: reads the arm's hash-chained journal through the evaluator's own Journal, re-parses every completed terminated response with parse_label and refuses any disagreement with the recorded canonical label

deviations_from_v1: Weights: author bf16 instead of the 8-bit MLX conversion (identity_change_vs_v1).
Engine and random stream: transformers CPU and torch.Generator instead of mlx-vlm and MLX; sampling definition unchanged.
Sharded over 3 hosts with a refusing merge; budgets per shard.
Comparison arms are named (W, RL400, strongest SFT) and image accuracy gets its own paired bootstrap.
resume_and_journal: run_local attempts.jsonl: each image is reserved (fsynced) before generation; an interrupted reservation is unknown_after_interruption and never regenerated; completed answers, including invalid ones, are never repeated; a resume with any identity change (model files, prompt, pixels, seed, profile, runtime versions, sources) is refused before model load. The runner's ledger.jsonl carries the budget clock.
runner: scripts/aircraft_named_baseline_v2.py (tests: tests/test_aircraft_named_baseline_v2.py, fake backend; tests/test_local_hf.py for the sampler, torch only)
